description:
Get Target Enabling Package (TEP) information.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table target — one record = one Ensembl human gene.
Key: id.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
pathways: mixed direct and propagated annotations.
go: direct annotations only.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty (null) result is not evidence of absence. Target Enabling Packages (SGC); null means the gene has no TEP in the programme or is not curated, not a verified absence.

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
